source_of_truth: Read by hand in a Next.js App Router app. Defect 1: src/shared/format.ts (shared code) imports getPlan (runtime, line 1) and type Plan (type-only, line 2) from @/features/billing; shared code must not depend on a business domain, so each import is shared-imports-domain (the runtime one high severity, the type-only one low). Defect 2: src/features/reports/report.ts imports @/features/users/internal/db, a private file of the users module, bypassing users/index.ts -> feature-internal-import. The reports page importing reports/report.ts is NOT a defect because reports has no index.ts public entry to bypass.

expected.rationale: runtime import of getPlan from the billing domain by shared code; explicit resolved import => confirmed, high severity.
type-only import of Plan from the billing domain by shared code; still coupling at design time, reported at confirmed confidence, low severity.
imports @/features/users/internal/db, a private file of the users module, instead of users/index.ts.

forbidden.why_not_a_defect: the page imports reports/report.ts, but the reports module has no index.ts, so there is no public entry being bypassed
